checks.title: Real waiting updates and offline shell retain both palettes

assertions.name: dark real waiting banner has readable theme colors and 44px controls
dark dismissal keeps the waiting worker and current document
dark explicit update refreshes once and restores saved appearance
dark real offline cold navigation loads only the application shell
light real waiting banner has readable theme colors and 44px controls
light dismissal keeps the waiting worker and current document
light explicit update refreshes once and restores saved appearance
light real offline cold navigation loads only the application shell

limitations: Desktop Chrome automation does not validate iPhone Safari, installed PWA, or a real Unraid host.
Playwright fulfill cannot stream SSE. Only /events is redirected by route.continue to this script's temporary synthetic streaming server; all REST fixtures are returned directly by route.fulfill.
Snapshot content is checked by separate old/new screenshots plus before/after semantic DOM evidence; screenshot pixel differences alone are not OCR.

Real hidden/visible lifecycle remains unverified: headless and headed local Chrome, tab activation, window minimization, Page.setWebLifecycleState, and disabled CDP focus emulation all retained visible. No fabricated visibility events are used. See visibility-probe.json.
No npm ci, application unit tests, build, Go tests, or image checks are performed by this browser-only script.
